> example:  for _,t in ipairs(scan(5)) do print(t.name) end

data.text: Carved letters on the stone: 'THE TERMINAL BESIDE ME OBEYS LUA. Stand next to it and use program, with Lua code as your text. It runs your code every 20 heartbeats. It can say("words") aloud, scan(10) to list what is near it, find("copper") to learn where the nearest copper (or clay, or berries...) lies, time() to tell the day, print(x) on its screen, and keep things in memory. A program that is only a question, like find("clay"), shows its answer on the screen. Try: say("hello")'
